# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta13

Fixes an infinite-loading bug in the built-in browser on macOS.

## Browser fix

- **macOS browser no longer hangs on "loading" forever.** The browser's per-request network gate ran an unbounded DNS lookup for every request (including the main document). On macOS, AAAA/IPv6 resolution for some hosts can stall `getaddrinfo`, which froze the gate and made the page load spin indefinitely. The lookup is now bounded to 4 seconds; on timeout the request is allowed through and the explicit proxy's own bounded policy check (`resolveTarget`) still enforces private-network / cloud-metadata blocking, so security is preserved — only the hang is removed.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
